svg.title: Nano V3-B001 paired position-reflection result
svg.desc: Every one of 27 matched seeds contributes control and position-reflected LEFT and RIGHT episodes. The figure reports the frozen full-sample endpoint-redirection and requested-depth estimands with deterministic paired-bootstrap intervals and exact paired sign tests.

Robot, cameras, and nonmovable geometry remain fixed, so this is neither a full-scene symmetry test nor causal attribution to training data.","estimands":{"B[a,i]":"(-s[a,i,right]) - s[a,i,left]","D[a,i]":"s[a,i,left] - s[a,i,right]","I[i]":"B[position_mirrored,i] - B[control,i]","J[i]":"D[position_mirrored,i] - D[control,i]","s":"signed_final_lateral_offset_m; positive is robot LEFT"},"exact_prompts":{"left":"Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.","right":"Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl."},"schema_version":"vla-wam-shared-v3b-nano-v3b001-scientific-figure-v1","source_sha256":{"episodes":"ce67aecb2705394e8161fa4b65df7130e62648e2f6d8b6a93408c8da685a7207","summary":"f43636a03caade5f3dc65de6736808c8257c78eacb07ba4cb963bfc6a0e36578"},"study_id":"vla_wam_language_steerability_v3","uncertainty_contract":{"bootstrap":"deterministic paired nonparametric percentile","bootstrap_master_seed":3104159,"bootstrap_replicates":20000,"median_interval":"exact distribution-free order-statistic interval","multiplicity_adjustment":"none; estimands are prespecified and reported separately","robust_test":"exact two-sided paired sign test with zero ties excluded","unit":"matched_seed"}}

g.text: Positions-only movable-object reflection · 108 valid episodes · all valid failures retained
Put the Rubik's cube to the left of the bowl.
Put the Rubik's cube to the right of the bowl.
Each seed contributes control LEFT, control RIGHT, position-reflected LEFT, and position-reflected RIGHT.
The primary full-sample analysis includes successes and behavioral failures; infrastructure attempts and imputation are excluded.
What the four frozen estimands measure
Positive: endpoints follow the requested LEFT-to-RIGHT ordering.
Positive: RIGHT finishes deeper in its requested side than LEFT.
Positive: endpoint separation is larger after position reflection.
Positive: the RIGHT-over-LEFT depth contrast is larger after reflection.
Dots are matched seeds; thick lines are deterministic paired-bootstrap 95% CIs; circles are means and diamonds are medians.
D is evaluated within each layout; J is the position-reflected minus control change in D.
estimand value (cm) · green side follows the positive definition
B compares RIGHT and LEFT requested margins within each layout; I is the reflected minus control change in B.
estimand value (cm) · green side follows the positive definition
Task outcomes remain a separate diagnostic
21/27 seeds had all four cells correct; unmatched successful cells were not mixed and failures were not encoded as zero.
Viewport video of executed robot behavior; this is the behavioral episode.
A 33-frame model future exposed at one policy request; not execution and not an additional episode.
Mean CIs use matched-seed percentile bootstrap; p is the exact two-sided paired sign test with zero ties excluded. No multiplicity adjustment.

text.tspan: The position-reflection interaction tests whether directional bias changes under the registered movable-object center-position reflection. Robot,
cameras, and nonmovable geometry remain fixed, so this is neither a full-scene symmetry test nor causal attribution to training data.
